description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the AccessControlList interface, including methods for creating, merging, setting, removing, and querying ACL entries, as well as JSON serialization. It is a core class for managing access control policies within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlList
classes.description: Immutable implementation of AccessControlList, providing methods for managing ACL entries, merging, serialization, and permission checks.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty AccessControlList.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AccessControlList initialized with given AclEntry or iterable of AclEntries.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ACL from a JSON object.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an AclEntry or permissions into the ACL, returning a new ACL instance.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets or replaces an ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: setForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets permissions for all authorization subjects.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor
methods.description: Retrieves subjects authorized for specific permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the given context or subject has specified permissions.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: getPermissionsOf
methods.description: Gets permissions associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permissions from an authorization subject.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACL is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the ACL.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a set of all ACL entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of ACL entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over ACL entries.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to a JSON object with optional filtering.
